description: This Java class 'EntityPermissionChecker' provides services for checking permissions related to content entities within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for permission validation, role and purpose retrieval, and permission condition evaluation, utilizing various helper classes and interfaces.

classes.name: EntityPermissionChecker
classes.description: Main class providing permission checking services for content entities, including permission validation, role and purpose retrieval, and permission condition evaluation.

classes.name: PermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Interface for iterating over permission conditions, retrieving role, operation, status, privilege, and auxiliary values.

classes.name: StdPermissionConditionGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of PermissionConditionGetter, retrieves permission conditions from a list of GenericValue entities.

classes.name: AuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Interface for obtaining auxiliary values related to permission checks.

classes.name: StdAuxiliaryValueGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of AuxiliaryValueGetter, retrieves auxiliary values from ContentPurpose entities.

classes.name: RelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Interface for obtaining related roles for entities, including initialization with or without ancestors.

classes.name: StdRelatedRoleGetter
classes.description: Standard implementation of RelatedRoleGetter, retrieves roles related to Content entities, including owner determination.

methods.name: runPermissionCheck
methods.description: Performs permission check based on context map, including permission condition evaluation and error message handling.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Static method to check permission for content, user, and operation parameters, returning a map with permission status.

methods.name: checkPermissionMethod
methods.description: Core static method that evaluates if a user has permission for specified entity IDs and operations, considering roles, purposes, and statuses.

methods.name: getNextEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the next entity (GenericValue) from a list or cache based on ID or entity object.

methods.name: checkHasRoleOperations
methods.description: Checks if a party has specific role-based operations.

methods.name: hasMatch
methods.description: Determines if an entity matches target operations, roles, purposes, and statuses.

methods.name: hasMatch
methods.description: Overloaded method to evaluate if permission conditions match for a given entity, role, status, and auxiliary values.

methods.name: getRelatedPurposes
methods.description: Retrieves related purposes for an entity, including inherited purposes.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Fetches user roles associated with an entity, considering group memberships.

methods.name: isGroupMember
methods.description: Checks if a user belongs to a specified group based on party relationships.

methods.name: getUserRolesFromList
methods.description: Retrieves distinct user roles from a list of entity IDs for a given party.

methods.name: getEntityOwners
methods.description: Recursively retrieves owner entity IDs for a given entity.

methods.name: getPrivilegeEnumSeq
methods.description: Fetches the sequence number of a privilege enumeration ID.
